comp-mobp4hhr.html: INFORMATION ON THE PROCESSING OF PERSONAL DATA

comp-mobp1zgc.html:
DataVision s.r.o. respects your privacy and the protection of your personal data. The purpose of this Privacy Policy is to transparently inform you about what personal data we process, for what purposes, on what legal basis, to whom personal data may be disclosed, how long we retain it and what rights you have in connection with the processing of your personal data.

​

This information is provided in particular in accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016, the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”), and in accordance with Act No. 110/2019 Coll., on the Processing of Personal Data. In connection with the use of cookies and similar technologies, we also proceed in accordance with Act No. 127/2005 Coll., on Electronic Communications.

​

This Privacy Policy applies to the general processing of personal data by DataVision s.r.o., in particular in connection with the operation of the corporate website, business communication, enquiries, quotations, contractual relationships, recruitment and ordinary administrative activities.

​

Separate privacy notices, data processing terms, data processing agreements or other product-specific documents may apply to certain standalone products or services of DataVision, including in particular the SaaS services MASKIT and SHOWIT and others. Where separate data protection or data processing terms have been issued for a specific product or service, such product-specific documents shall apply preferentially to the processing of personal data within that product or service.

comp-motx6v7q.html:
What personal data do we process?

​

Depending on your relationship with us, we may process in particular the following categories of personal data:

​

Identification and contact details

We may process your name, surname, job title, company name, company identification number, VAT number, registered office or business address, e-mail address, telephone number and other contact details that you provide to us or that are publicly available.

​

Data related to business communication

We may process data contained in enquiries, orders, quotations, contracts, meeting notes, e-mail communication, presentations, project documentation and other documents related to business or project communication.

​

Data related to contract performance

We process personal data necessary for the preparation, conclusion and performance of contracts, provision of services, project delivery, invoicing, accounting, customer relationship management, technical support, complaint handling, project management and protection of our legal claims.

​

Data of job applicants and prospective collaborators

If you apply for a job or another form of cooperation, we may process data included in your CV, cover letter, portfolio, professional network profile, information about your education, professional experience, qualifications, skills, remuneration expectations and other data that you provide to us during the recruitment or selection process.

​

Technical data and website data

When you visit our websites, we may process technical data, in particular your IP address, device type, browser type, operating system, language settings, date and time of visit, pages visited, website interaction data and data obtained through cookies or similar technologies.

 

Marketing data

We may process information about whether you have given us consent to receive marketing communication, whether you have unsubscribed from commercial communication, what commercial messages we have sent to you and, where applicable, how you interacted with them.

 

Data from public sources

To a reasonable extent, we may also process data obtained from publicly available sources, in particular commercial registers, trade registers, professional databases, company websites, LinkedIn or other publicly available sources, especially for the purposes of business communication, verification of data and development of business relationships.

comp-motxb0em.html:
For what purposes and on what legal basis do we process personal data?

​

We process personal data only where we have an appropriate legal basis under the GDPR.

 

Handling enquiries and business communication

If you contact us via a web form, e-mail, telephone, social media or otherwise, we process your personal data for the purpose of handling your enquiry, preparing a quotation, conducting business negotiations and communicating about potential cooperation.

 

Legal basis: steps prior to entering into a contract, where the communication is aimed at entering into a contract; legitimate interest in business communication and development of business relationships.

 

Conclusion and performance of contracts

If you are our customer, supplier, business partner or a contact person of such an entity, we process your personal data for the purpose of concluding, performing and managing the contractual relationship, delivering projects, providing services, providing support, communicating with you and handling your requests.

 

Legal basis: performance of a contract, steps prior to entering into a contract, legitimate interest and compliance with legal obligations.

 

Accounting, tax and compliance with legal obligations

We process certain personal data for the purpose of accounting, issuing tax documents and complying with tax, accounting and other legal obligations.

​

Legal basis: compliance with legal obligations.

 

Protection of rights and legal claims

We may also process personal data for the purpose of protecting our rights, handling complaints, collecting receivables, conducting disputes, proving compliance with obligations, preventing damage and managing security or legal risks.

 

Legal basis: legitimate interest.

 

Marketing communication

If you are our customer or business contact, we may send you relevant commercial communication concerning our services, products, expert content, news or events, provided that this is in accordance with applicable law. In other cases, we send you marketing communication on the basis of your consent.You may unsubscribe from commercial communication at any time via the unsubscribe link in the e-mail or by contacting us at the e-mail address stated above.

​

Legal basis: legitimate interest or consent.

​

Recruitment and selection of employees and collaborators

If you apply for employment or another form of cooperation, we process your personal data for the purpose of conducting the selection process, assessing your qualifications, communicating with you and potentially entering into a contract.If you give us your consent, we may also retain your personal data for future recruitment or selection processes.

​

Legal basis: steps prior to entering into a contract, legitimate interest or consent.

 

Operation, security and improvement of websites

We process technical data necessary for the operation of our websites, their security, prevention of misuse, resolution of technical issues and improvement of their content and functionality.

 

Legal basis: legitimate interest; in the case of analytical and marketing cookies, consent where required by applicable law.

 

Fulfilment of requirements related to our services

DataVision provides services in particular in the areas of artificial intelligence, computer vision, image processing, software development, automation, SaaS solutions and development or integration of specialised systems. In connection with these activities, we may process personal data necessary for the analysis of customer requirements, preparation of solutions, project implementation, testing, support and other related activities.In some cases, when providing services, we may act as a processor of personal data on behalf of our customer. In such case, the processing is governed by a separate contract, data processing agreement or other appropriate arrangement with the customer.

 

Legal basis: performance of a contract, steps prior to entering into a contract, legitimate interest or data processing agreement.

comp-motxlhvh.html:
Cookies and similar technologies

Our websites may use cookies and similar technologies. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that enable website functionality, remembering certain settings, measuring traffic or personalising content and marketing.We use in particular the following types of cookies:

 

Necessary cookies

These cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of the websites and cannot be disabled through our cookie tool. Without these cookies, some parts of the website may not function properly.

 

Legal basis: legitimate interest in operating the websites; consent is not required for the storage or reading of these cookies where they are necessary for providing a service explicitly requested by the user.

 

Analytical cookies

Analytical cookies help us understand how visitors use our websites, which pages are visited most often and how we can improve the website.

 

Legal basis: consent, where required by applicable law.

 

Marketing cookies

Marketing cookies may be used for advertising measurement and targeting, remarketing, campaign evaluation or integration with third-party advertising platforms.

 

Legal basis: consent. You may change or withdraw your consent to the use of cookies at any time through the cookie banner or cookie settings on our website. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

 

The specific list of cookies used, their providers, purposes and retention periods is provided in the cookie settings on our website or in a separate Cookie Notice, if published.

comp-motxvykk.html:
To whom do we disclose your personal data?

​

We may disclose your personal data only to the extent necessary and only where this is necessary for the purposes described above or where required by law.

 

Personal data may be disclosed in particular to the following categories of recipients:

​

  • providers of IT services, hosting, cloud services, website administration and cybersecurity,

  • providers of e-mail, CRM, accounting, invoicing, project management and communication tools,

  • external accounting, tax, legal, technical and other professional advisers,

  • providers of marketing, analytical and advertising tools,

  • business partners, where necessary for project implementation, handling an enquiry or performing a contract,

  • public authorities, courts, administrative authorities or other authorised entities, where required by law or necessary for the protection of our rights.

 

With providers who process personal data on our behalf as processors, we enter into appropriate data processing agreements or other legally required arrangements.

comp-motxyq8r.html:
Transfers of personal data outside the EU/EEA

​

We primarily process personal data within the European Union or the European Economic Area.

​

In some cases, however, personal data may also be transferred to third countries, in particular where we use cloud, analytical, communication, CRM, marketing or other technology tools provided by global providers.

​

Where personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure that such transfer is based on appropriate safeguards under the GDPR, in particular an adequacy decision of the European Commission, standard contractual clauses, supplementary security measures or another appropriate legal mechanism.

comp-motxzxum.html:
How long do we retain personal data?

 

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or for the period required by applicable law.

 

In general, the following retention periods apply:

 

  • data related to enquiries and business communication is retained for the duration of the business communication and subsequently for a reasonable period for the protection of our legitimate interests,

  • data related to contractual relationships is retained for the duration of the contract and subsequently for the period necessary for the protection of legal claims,

  • accounting and tax documents are retained for the period required by applicable law,

  • data of job applicants is retained for the duration of the selection process, or longer only on the basis of consent or another legal basis,

  • data processed on the basis of consent is retained for the period for which the consent was granted or until its withdrawal,

  • cookies are retained according to their type and the settings specified in the cookie banner or Cookie Notice.

 

After the relevant retention period expires, personal data is deleted, anonymised or securely archived where necessary for compliance with legal obligations or protection of legal claims.

comp-moty26t6.html:
What are your rights?

 

In connection with the processing of personal data, you have in particular the following rights under the conditions set out in the GDPR:

 

  • the right of access to personal data,

  • the right to rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data,

  • the right to erasure of personal data,

  • the right to restriction of processing,

  • the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest,

  • the right to data portability,

  • the right to withdraw consent, where processing is based on consent,

  • the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, where the conditions under the GDPR are met,

  • the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

 

You may exercise your rights by contacting us at:

​

gdpr@datavision.cz

​

If you believe that we process your personal data in violation of applicable law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, which in the Czech Republic is:

 

Office for Personal Data Protection, Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, Czech Republic

Website: www.uoou.gov.cz

comp-moty6ytk.html:
Security of personal data

 

We adopt appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration, disclosure or destruction.

 

These measures may include in particular access rights management, use of secured IT systems, encryption where appropriate, backup procedures, internal rules for handling data, contractual safeguards when using external providers and regular assessment of security measures.

comp-moty7x08.html:
Processing of personal data in services provided to customers

 

In some services provided to our customers, DataVision may process personal data provided by the customer or processed within a customer project.

 

In such cases, DataVision may act as a processor of personal data and the customer may act as the controller of personal data. The specific terms of such processing are set out in the contract with the customer, a data processing agreement or another appropriate contractual document.

 

If, in a specific case, we act as an independent controller of personal data, the processing is governed by this Privacy Policy or another privacy notice provided to the relevant individuals.

comp-moty95ey.html:
Automated decision-making

 

In the ordinary operation of our websites and business communication, we do not carry out decision-making based solely on automated processing that would produce legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affect you.

​

If automated decision-making or profiling within the meaning of the GDPR takes place in connection with a specific service or project, we will inform the affected individuals separately.

comp-motya921.html:
Changes to this Privacy Policy

​

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, in particular due to changes in legal regulations, our services, technologies used or internal processes.

​

The current version of this Privacy Policy will always be published on our websites. We recommend that you review this Privacy Policy regularly.
